fields.headline: EVERY HOLE COUNTS.
fields.body: The scoring model that changes how a team Cup feels.

fields.headline: ONE POINT A HOLE.
fields.body: Win the hole, take the point. Halve it, share it. 18 points a match, every match, every session.

fields.headline: NOBODY WALKS IN.
fields.body: Traditional match play ends when the match is decided. Every hole counts keeps every pair playing to the last green, because the 17th still matters when you are four down.

fields.headline: YOUR CALL.
fields.body: Choose every hole counts or traditional match play once, for the whole Cup. Golf Sessions scores either, live, on every phone.

fields.headline:
YOUR CUP.
LIVE.
fields.body: Free to build, pay to publish, free to play.
